description: This file contains a collection of shell functions primarily used in OpenWrt firmware for configuring system settings, managing packages, users, groups, and hardware components, as well as utility functions like data conversion and checksum operations.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if DEBUG is set.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Performs XOR operation on multiple hex values of the same length.

methods.name: data_2bin
methods.description: Converts hex string data to binary format.

methods.name: data_2xor_val
methods.description: Extracts XOR value from hex data.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to a variable with optional separator.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Prepends a value to a variable with optional separator.

methods.name: list_contains
methods.description: Checks if a list variable contains a specific string.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration using UCI unless in IPKG_INSTROOT.

methods.name: reset_cb
methods.description: Resets configuration callback functions to default no-op.

methods.name: package
methods.description: Stub function for package handling.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Defines a new configuration section.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Sets an option within the current config section.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Adds a list item to a configuration.

methods.name: config_unset
methods.description: Unsets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value, supports default.

methods.name: get_bool
methods.description: Converts various string representations to boolean (0/1).

methods.name: config_get_bool
methods.description: Retrieves and converts a config value to boolean.

methods.name: config_set
methods.description: Sets a specific config option.

methods.name: config_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over configuration sections of a given type.

methods.name: config_list_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over items in a list configuration.

methods.name: default_prerm
methods.description: Runs pre-removal scripts for a package.

methods.name: add_group_and_user
methods.description: Creates necessary system users and groups based on package info.

methods.name: update_alternatives
methods.description: Manages symbolic links for package alternatives.

methods.name: default_postinst
methods.description: Runs post-installation scripts including enabling services and copying over overlays.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other shell scripts from a directory.

methods.name: ipcalc
methods.description: Runs ipcalc.sh and exports its output variables.

methods.name: find_mtd_index
methods.description: Finds MTD partition index by name.

methods.name: find_mtd_part
methods.description: Gets device path for an MTD partition.

methods.name: find_mmc_part
methods.description: Finds MMC partition device by name.

methods.name: group_add
methods.description: Adds a system group.

methods.name: group_exists
methods.description: Checks if a group exists.

methods.name: group_add_next
methods.description: Finds the next available GID and adds group.

methods.name: group_add_user
methods.description: Adds a user to a group.

methods.name: user_add
methods.description: Creates a new system user.

methods.name: user_exists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists.

methods.name: board_name
methods.description: Retrieves the board name string.

methods.name: cmdline_get_var
methods.description: Extracts a variable from /proc/cmdline.
